Documentation / Modpacks

Make Chisel belong in your pack.

Keep versions aligned, connect outside blocks to Chisel families, and tune the experience without maintaining a custom fork.

Data-pack friendlyServer configurableNeoForge

Dependencies and versions

Chisel requires CTM. Package both files and make sure all three version lines—Minecraft, Chisel, and CTM—belong to the same release family.

ComponentCurrent project baselineRole
Chisel26.1.2.18Blocks, tools, recipes, menus, and family logic
CTM26.1.2.8Required connected-texture rendering library
NeoForge26.1.2.106+Mod loader and platform APIs
Pack clients and servers consistently. Chisel belongs on both sides. Test a dedicated server separately from an integrated single-player world before releasing the pack.

Add blocks to a variant family

Every Chisel family has a common block tag, typically c:chisel/<family_name>. A datapack can add blocks from Minecraft or another mod to that family, allowing conversion in both directions.

  1. Identify the family name, such as aluminum.
  2. Create data/c/tags/block/chisel/aluminum.json in your datapack or KubeJS data resources.
  3. Add the external block IDs under values.
  4. Reload and confirm every block has an item form and behaves sensibly when converted.
data/c/tags/block/chisel/aluminum.json
{
  "replace": false,
  "values": [
    "minecraft:iron_block",
    "examplemod:aluminum_block"
  ]
}
Do not replace the family tag. Keep "replace": false unless you intentionally want to discard every entry provided by Chisel and other datapacks.

Configure durability

Chisel's common startup configuration controls durability for each tool tier. The generated file is config/chisel_common.toml.

config/chisel_common.toml
[general]
iron_chisel_durability = 512
diamond_chisel_durability = 5096
obsidian_chisel_durability = 10048

Set a durability value to 0 to disable durability for that chisel. Because these are startup settings, restart the game or server after changing them.

Compatibility strategy

  • Prefer tags for simple family membership. This is the smallest and most maintainable integration point.
  • Let the owning mod provide resources. Chisel does not generate models, textures, loot tables, or translations inside another mod's namespace.
  • Test connected textures with resource packs. Model overrides can change or remove the texture slots CTM expects.
  • Check recipes with JEI. Chisel exposes its conversions through JEI when that integration is present.
  • Avoid duplicate memberships. A block should not belong to conflicting Chisel families.

If your integration needs a new family, custom registration, or model metadata—not just membership—use the developer addon API.

Pack release checklist

  • Launch a clean client with the exact exported pack files.
  • Join a dedicated server and open both Chisel and Auto Chisel menus.
  • Verify custom family-tag blocks convert in both directions.
  • Place connected glass and at least one multiblock texture across a chunk boundary.
  • Confirm chisel durability matches the intended pack balance.
  • Keep the full log and exported mod list for issue reports.
